text.title: Pledge at Oakhaven
text.body: Beyond the mountain descent, Oakhaven's timber frontier is buckling under starving raider packs while Master Shipwright Kors races to build the evacuation fleet. Rearm at the Ironwood Armory, smash the canyon roadblock, and relieve Captain Bram at the Northern Watch Post before his banner falls.
text.obj.0: Clear the canyon roadblock and the siege pack
text.obj.1: Reach the Northern Post with Captain Bram alive
text.msg.1: Raiders choke the central pass and a siege pack gathers beneath Captain Bram's post. Gear up in Oakhaven—Miner Gorin's freed quarry smiths are already hammering ironstone plates onto Kors's hulls—and march north!
text.msg.2: Horn blasts echo across the pine ridge—the siege pack charges Captain Bram's post!
text.msg.3: The eastern ridge redoubt is breached; our spearmen secure the plundered garrison lockbox holding five hundred silver coins!
text.msg.4: The pass and siege lines are broken! Ride up to the Northern Post to seal the gateway to the coast.
text.msg.5: Oakhaven's torn standard rises again over the pass! The northern gateway to the coast holds!
text.npc.bailiff: Take sea-tempered steel from Master-at-Arms Toren's armory and enlist blades at the tavern before forcing the pass. Bailiff Aldric studies Morvessa's Signet Ring on your hand and closes his eyes in grim recognition: 'So the auditors finally paid their own balance.'
text.win: The Oakhaven frontier is secured and the northern gateway to the coast holds.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell on the Oakhaven frontier road.
text.fail.2: Captain Bram was slain and the northern watch post fell.
